integrity: Analytic proof supplied for every quantified statement; standard-library numerical checks corroborate but do not replace it. Primary-source historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Distinct equal-weight six-point circular 2-designs, equal positive edge lengths, and ordinary Euclidean area only; smaller design sizes are treated for rigidity. The sharp upper coefficient is a limiting, not attained, nonzero ratio. Historical priority remains provisional, especially for older circle-design and equilateral-hexagon literature. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Third-harmonic area rigidity for six-normal circular designs
